protocol.name: meter-first full-store rho, 1024 workers declared, depth 6, store priced as shipped

abort.event: #{aborts at S} <= #{guard_conversions} = 4497 (each abort needs an ARMED counter, armed is set only on a guard step and cleared on restart, so distinct aborts consume distinct arming guards)

detection.mechanism: the shipped dict28_wide_lookup hit, followed by THE TRAIL COMPARISON now in the protocol (scripts/protocol28.py, run_one): a hit counts as a collision only when the stored trail id differs from the arriving worker's; same-trail hits are counted and discarded because G.recover() has den = (D2 - q^k D1) = 0 there
detection.kappa_source: evidence/arm35.json, injected-collision arm at the production lambda

census_fidelity.why: trail >= guard ring (6) for guard stationarity; only the partition series at fixed S carries the W-dependence

store_spec_to_code.shipped_structure: 2 levels of the shipped type: nb = 2^63 per level, all fields u64

production_layout.rule: 2 levels of the shipped type: nb = 2^63 per level, all fields u64
production_layout.lambda_definition: lambda_bucket = arrivals / heads (occupancy per bucket head)
production_layout.v34_withdrawn: 2^128 bucket heads / 2^130 node capacity: dict28_ws_init takes u64 nb and ws_bucket masks 64 bits, so neither is representable or addressable

store_spec_to_code.lambda_rule: lambda = arrivals / heads = S / 2^126; the v34 heads value (lambda 0.2815) is withdrawn because the shipped field is u64 and ws_bucket masks 64 bits (evidence/historical-disclosure.json)
store_spec_to_code.v34_withdrawn: 2^128 bucket heads / 2^130 node capacity: dict28_ws_init takes u64 nb and ws_bucket masks 64 bits, so neither is representable or addressable

measured_retention_at_production_lambda.delta_explanation: 1-P(Poisson(lambda)>=5) is the terminal-size limit for an insertion-only bucket; the shipped chain evicts during fill as well, so the measured loss is larger. Both are reported; the LOWER of the two is used.

measured_kappa_detect.definition: P(true cross-trail key collision is DETECTED) = P(the earlier record is resident and the shipped dict28_wide_lookup returns its reference at the later arrival). Injected-collision control: uniformly chosen earlier key replayed through the shipped lookup.

row_anchors.fp12_dense_mulmod: executed f12mul span x the number of non-guard steps; the 6-limb Montgomery CIOS chain is inside this measured span
row_anchors.fp12_guard_cyclo_sqr: executed cyclotomic-square span x the guard-step count
row_anchors.scalar_coefficient_update: 2 x ceil(MUL_CHARGE/72) + 12, the same anchor discipline as the walk row

bounds_table.bound_formula: one flag per record + the 8-byte trail id the v35 gate reads
<= PROBES = 4 (chain full triggers the shipped FIFO eviction)

bounds_table.source_constant: 6 key words + 2 ref words + 2 evicted words
calloc(nb, sizeof(ws_node *)); nb a u64 power of two, ws_bucket masks 64 bits
sizeof(ws_node) = 96 B, one per live record
bounds_table.bound_formula: min(arrivals, capacity) = S nodes x 96 B

type_table.code_type: u64 d28_ws_live (fixture); capacity = PROBES x heads
Python int (ledger) / u64 counter in the fixture

claim.rule: minimal n with 20000*2^(n/10000) >= W; exact integer test

success.rule: p_used = p5 x kappa_lower_3se, the detection debit charged explicitly
